ingredients: 25 g Dijon mustard, plus extra to serve
Pinch each of sea salt and black pepper

groups.heading: Method
steps: Boil the eggs 5 minutes, refresh in iced water 20 minutes and peel.
Mix the sausage meat with the mustards, herbs, yolk, breadcrumbs and seasoning. Divide into 6 and flatten each into a 1 cm patty.
Mould each patty around an egg without overlapping too much. Chill 1 hour.
Roll in salted flour, then egg, then panko, shaping in your hands. Chill 30 minutes.
Deep-fry at 180°C about 2 minutes until golden. Drain, halve lengthways and serve with Dijon.
